CommunityApplications.Profile:
unraid-unzip adds right-click archive extraction to the built-in unRAID File Manager: extract `7z`, `zip`, `RAR`, `tar`, and the compressed tarballs (`.tar.gz`, `.tgz`, `.tar.bz2`, `.tar.xz`, `.tar.zst`) to a destination you choose, with saved passwords, exclude patterns, an overwrite policy, and background jobs.
Maintained by h4de5. Report issues in the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/h4de5/unraid-unzip/issues).
